name: dragsa-electron
description: Electron wrapper for dragsa — bundles Vite UI + the compiled tools backend binary.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:electron && npm run build:backend && npm run build:assets
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && npm run build:backend && cross-env DRAGSA_ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish always
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish always
scripts.dist:win: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.dist:win:x64: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always
scripts.dist:linux: npm run dist:prep && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish always
